subject: Technical deep dive: Redwood architecture review - scheduling
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Nguyen <samantha.nguyen@orbithealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Technical deep dive: Redwood architecture review - scheduling

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the discovery call yesterday — great context on your ingestion patterns and latency targets. Per our conversation, the best next step would be a 60–75 minute technical deep dive to walk Rajiv's team through Redwood's serving architecture, KV cache behavior, quantization options, and a short Q&A on integration points (VPC/private deployment and SSO).

Proposed time windows (PST):
- Thurs 12 Feb, 10:00–11:15am
- Thurs 12 Feb, 2:00–3:15pm
- Fri 13 Feb, 9:30–10:45am

I've attached a short agenda and an architecture one-pager for context. Please let me know which slot works or share times that are better for you and Rajiv.

Agenda (attached): 1) goals & success criteria, 2) architecture walkthrough, 3) integration touchpoints, 4) open Q&A + next steps.

Attachments: [attachment: pre-sales-agenda.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)], [attachment: redwood-architecture-overview.pdf (application/pdf)]

Thanks — happy to be flexible.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Nguyen <samantha.nguyen@orbithealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@orbithealth.com>, Emily Hart <emily.hart@orbithealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Technical deep dive: Redwood architecture review - scheduling

Hi Jonas —

Thanks — those look great. Rajiv is in another vendor review on Thurs morning and is only available in the afternoon. Thu 12 Feb, 2:00–3:15pm PST would work best for us. One ask: can you include a brief section on our current multi-region failover strategy and how KV cache warms across regions? Also, Emily from procurement will join for a few minutes to confirm next-step timelines.

If anything changes on our side, I will let you know, but please go ahead and pencil the 2pm slot.

Best,
Samantha
Director of Platform Engineering | OrbitHealth
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Technical deep dive: Redwood architecture review - scheduling

Team —

Samantha confirmed Thu 12 Feb 2:00–3:15pm PST for the deep dive with Rajiv (OrbitHealth). Emily from procurement will drop in. Please confirm who can present the architecture and who will handle the failover/KV cache questions (they asked specifically about cross-region warm-up).

Suggested roles: Laura — lead architecture walkthrough + integration notes; Dev — KV cache + multi-region behavior; Aisha — deployment/entitlements and next-step timeline (procurement handoff). Laura — can you own slides? Dev — can you prepare a short demo snippet or notes about cache warm-up?

I'll send the calendar invite after we confirm speakers.

—Jonas
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Technical deep dive: Redwood architecture review - scheduling

Thanks Jonas — I can take lead on the architecture walkthrough and will update the agenda. I have a 20-slide deck that covers the runtime, caching, and routing policies; I'll trim it to 12 slides for a tight 30–35 minute walk-through.

Dev — can you add 3–4 slides (or a short terminal demo) showing KV cache behavior across regions and cold-starts? If you want, I can slot the demo right after the architecture walkthrough.

Aisha — I'll add a one-slide summary of deployment options and entitlements for procurement.

I'll upload the updated deck and share a link by EOD tomorrow.

—Laura
